title: docs(gate): name key-refusal as a class check-spec-range-floors deliberately does not judge (objectui#9036)
body:
Fixes #9036

Ruling **A** on objectui#9036, dispatched from the PM claim on that card. The measurement round is ACCEPTed; this PR builds only what the ruling asked for.

## What changed

One section added to the header docblock of `scripts/check-spec-range-floors.mjs`. Nothing else.

The gate judges **symbol presence**. A floor that admits a spec which *declares* the symbol but *refuses the keys* a package writes into it is green either way — nothing in the gate ever parses a payload against the floor's own schema. The header did not say so, so a green run read as "these floors are behaviourally sound", which it is not.

Commandment **#9** requires prose implying coverage to point at the instrument, or to say that nothing re-derives the claim. This adds the second kind: the unjudged class is named, the boundary is stated as deliberate and measured, and objectui#9036 is pointed at for the measurement. **No figure is copied out of it** — that is commandment #9 applied to the new paragraph itself.

The section also records the trap that makes a naive behavioural leg confidently wrong: a key ABSENT from a schema does not imply the schema refuses it; whether the schema is CLOSED decides that, and it varies per schema and per version.

## Evidence

Every zero below carries a control proven able to return non-zero. Measured in a dedicated worktree at `a22b9e5404`, never in the shared checkout.

**1. Exactly one file, and no non-comment byte moved.**

`git diff --stat` against the merge-base `ff1d5ea8d1`: `1 file changed, 27 insertions(+)`.

Filtering the diff to added/removed lines that are not comment lines yields the **empty set**. Control: the same filter over a copy with `process.exit(0)` changed to `process.exit(3)` yields two lines, so the filter is capable of a hit.

Stronger form, using the repo's own comment masker (`scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs`, `maskComments`): masking both revisions and dropping blank lines gives **563 code lines on each side, byte-identical**. Control in the same run: the same comparator against the one-code-byte copy answers DIFFERS.

**2. Behaviour provably unchanged.**

`node scripts/check-spec-range-floors.mjs`, before and after: **exit 1 both times, output byte-identical** (sha256 `174c9ea6…` on both logs). The verdict is `no-artifact` for every published package because this worktree is not built — this gate is a release-path gate, so that run exercises the CLI path and not the verdict logic. The verdict logic is compared in (3).

**3. The gate's own test suite, which exercises the verdict logic against synthetic inputs.**

`pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-spec-range-floors.test.ts scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts` — **before: 2 files, 62 passed. After: 2 files, 62 passed.** Same counts, exit 0 both times.

Control (an ablation, restored and verified): changing `reason: 'no-artifact'` to `reason: 'no-artifact-ABLATED'` in the gate turns the floors suite red — `1 failed | 32 passed`. Restore leg `git checkout HEAD -- scripts/check-spec-range-floors.mjs` verified by blob hash `e7fcbb87cd…` matching `HEAD` and by `git diff HEAD` being empty. So the 62 green above is a measurement of this file, not of nothing.

**4. No count, census figure or fixture number in the added prose.**

Extracting every whitespace-delimited token containing a digit from the 27 added lines gives exactly three, all identifiers: `objectui#9036`, `(objectui#9036)`, `#9`. Control: the same extractor over the adjacent objectui#5793 section of the same header returns version literals, so it does find figures where they exist.

That absence is not only style. `scripts/check-installed-spec-pin-claims.mjs` already carries a ledger entry for one drifting version claim in this file; a version literal added here would either drift into a finding or sit in the live-at-pin half waiting to. The gate is green and its output is unchanged by this PR.

**5. Other gates that read this file's text, before and after.**

- `check-installed-spec-pin-claims` — exit 0 both, output identical.
- `check-control-bytes` — exit 0 both, output identical.
- `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` — exit 0 both; the only output delta is `Files compared: 0` becoming `1`, which is this branch's own diff entering its scope.
- `check-comment-mask-corpus` — exit 0 both; the only output delta is the elapsed-seconds digit.
- `eslint scripts/check-spec-range-floors.mjs` — exit 0.
- Control-byte self-scan over the file — no hits.

**6. Changeset: none owed, measured.**

`node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` — exit 0: *"No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed."* Control: appending one line to `packages/core/src/index.ts` makes the same gate exit 1 and demand a declaration; restored and verified by blob hash `012e314fe4…` matching `HEAD`.

**7. Governed surface: no.**

`node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test scripts/check-spec-range-floors.mjs` — exit 0, NOT GOVERNED. Control: the same command on `AGENTS.md` exits 3 and prints GOVERNED. This PR is still delivered as a **draft** because the dispatch order says draft; it is not waiting on a governed-surface approval.

## Acceptance notes

Out of scope, noted and not filed:

- The `no-artifact` early exit means a local run of this gate in an unbuilt worktree never reaches its verdict logic. That is by design (the ruling on objectui#4846 rejected a per-PR full-repo build) and the header already explains it. Carrier: this file; anyone editing the gate reads that section.
- `check-comment-mask-corpus` prints an elapsed time into its success line, which makes its output non-reproducible byte-for-byte across runs. Harmless — the gate's verdict does not read it. Carrier: none, and it is not worth one.

Neither is a reproducible defect, a declared-contract breach, or an AI-metadata trap, so neither is filed.
